changelog: Every playlist or album download now has its own page link — refresh, close Safari or reopen the link and the job status (or the finished ZIP) is right there
One link per playlist: start a job and the address bar switches to /p/<playlist id> automatically, so a refresh stays on the job
Copy link on the job card, so you can bookmark a running playlist or open it from another device on the same server
Download fixes from 2.1.1 stay in place: SoundCloud fallback when YouTube blocks the server, ffmpeg shipped with the app, and engine handover
devNotes:
## Development Notes

### Architecture
- **Backend**: FastAPI (app/main.py) with SpotAPI for Spotify metadata — no API keys required
- **Downloads**: yt-dlp / SpotDL across YouTube + SoundCloud (`AUDIO_SOURCES`), MP3 output, mutagen tagging with cover art
- **Hosting**: Render's datacenter IP is refused by YouTube, so SoundCloud is the working fallback. Set `YTDLP_COOKIES` (cookie file contents) or `YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE` to use YouTube.
- **Jobs**: app/api/playlists.py keeps batch jobs in memory; the client only stores the job id
- **Deep links**: `/p/<spotify id>` serves the SPA, which looks the job up via `GET /playlists/jobs/by-playlist/<id>`
- **Streaming**: HTTP range streaming from /files/stream
- **Frontend**: vanilla JS (static/app.js), no framework, no build step
- **Themes**: 18 CSS custom-property themes in static/styles.css
- **Worker**: static/download-poll-worker.js polls tasks and jobs off the main thread

### Key files
| File | Purpose |
|------|--------|
| app/main.py | FastAPI entry point, routers, `/p/<id>` deep link, static mount |
| app/api/playlists.py | ZIP creation, album tracks, playlist jobs, job lookup by playlist id |
| app/api/download.py | Single download task management |
| app/api/search.py | Spotify search proxy |
| app/services/downloader_service.py | yt-dlp / SpotDL download + tagging pipeline |
| app/services/download_task_manager.py | In-memory task tracker with semaphore + TTL cleanup |
| static/app.js | Frontend: routing, deep links, search, playlist picker, jobs, player, themes |
| static/styles.css | Theme tokens + all layout |
| static/index.html | SPA shell |

### Known issues
- Jobs and tasks are in-memory: a Render restart clears them (files on disk are ephemeral too)
- Job links stop resolving after the 2h job TTL, and a deploy or spin-down clears them sooner
- Playlists are capped at 200 tracks per job
- YouTube downloads need cookies on Render; SoundCloud is used otherwise

### Upcoming
- Persistent job storage so a deploy does not lose a running batch or its page link
- Shuffle/repeat in Now Playing
- Offline PWA shell
